label: TermOutcome
prompt: Present admitted paid-term collection and cancellation states, paid flag, frozen start/end interval, price and source reference. Keep collection observation separate from entitlement: the paid flag remains its canonical declared value. Use canonical localized field and exact money formatting. Leave refund-access policy, mail benefit, invoice reference, seat count, eligibility guards and all forms/actions at each caller.
interface_status: Provisional handwritten ABI; no compiler or runtime support claimed
definition_style_prompt: Use distinct readable outcome badges, a compact term interval and exact price, with a wrapping source reference; inherit the current theme.
